facts.fact: 10/15：代课老师 Mrs. Tracy 宣布 Collins「休假」，且要找「永久替代」——他被停职了。
facts.anchor: I’ll be substituting for Mr. Collins, who is currently on leave.

facts.fact: Peyton 在校车上说了句「回头见，学分小姐，走好不送」——她早知道这一天会来。
facts.anchor: “See you around, Extra Credit,” she singsongs. “Good riddance.”

facts.fact: 校长 Hargrove 的指控：校董会收到举报，Max 与老师有「不当关系」。
facts.anchor: It has come to the school board’s attention that you and a teacher at this school may have engaged in an inappropriate relationship.

facts.fact: 证据照片：她穿着周日的短裤背心在自家门廊拥抱 Collins——被人偷拍，只有画面没有语境。
facts.anchor: It’s me. Me and Mr. Collins. On my front porch.

facts.fact: 她醒悟：有人偷拍并一直在监视她——照片是精心构图的陷阱。
facts.anchor: Someone took a picture of us. Someone was watching us.

facts.fact: 储物柜里搜出栽赃的处方药 Vicodin（瓶上名字被刮掉）——与 ch22 的 Xanax 是同一套「升级」手段。
父亲崩溃质问：你妈经历过那些之后？——他把 Max 和她母亲混为一谈。
父亲的低语：我觉得完全不认识你了——这句话比任何指控都更伤她。
facts.anchor: I feel like I don’t know you at all anymore.

facts.fact: Collins 昨晚被解除职务、禁止入校——他的名声因一张照片被毁。
facts.anchor: He was removed from his position last night

facts.fact: Max 的定性：这不是误会，是报复——Peyton 对她「不听话」的清算。
facts.anchor: This is payback for not following her rules.

facts.fact: 小镇的羞辱标签重现——「有其母必有其女」是她的红字。
facts.anchor: Like mother, like daughter. Yep. I’ve heard that one before. It’s practically my fucking scarlet letter.

facts.fact: Max 的推理：Peyton 一早就把今天的剧本写好了——像 Christopher Nolan 导演她垮台的电影。
facts.anchor: Peyton knew exactly what my day was going to look like before I even got up that morning.

facts.fact: 真正动机：这一切从来都是因为 Milo——Peyton 受不了他心里有一块永远属于 Max。
facts.anchor: It’s about Milo. It’s always been about Milo.

facts.fact: 她做出痛苦决定：要让它停止，只能放弃 Milo——Peyton 赢了。
facts.anchor: I have to give up Milo.

facts.fact: 她给 Milo 发「对不起」并拉黑——隔着窗帘看着 Reds 的「胜利巡游」，她亲手推开唯一的光。
facts.anchor: Before he has a chance to respond, I block his number.
